landing.tagline: Real Problems, Real Impact, Real Careers.
landing.h1a: Prove what you can do on
landing.sub: Kadam gives college students real problems from small businesses and NGOs. Solve one, and Kadam turns the result into an impact report you can put on your resume.
landing.cta_business: I have a problem to solve
landing.not_portal: Not a job board. Real work, judged on real outcomes.
landing.card_title: Grew tiffin subscriptions for a women-run kitchen
landing.card_meta: Rohan M. · B.Com · Annapurna Tiffin, Bengaluru
landing.card_bullet: Grew monthly subscriptions from 38 to 81 in six weeks with a ₹1,800 budget.
landing.walls_title: Students graduate with degrees, but without proof of what they can do.
landing.wall1_sub: Which careers fit you, and which ones could you move into?
landing.wall2_sub: College projects are never used by a real organisation, and never measured.
landing.wall3_sub: What to learn, in what order, and how to prove it.
landing.stat3: of digitally hesitant MSMEs lack technical skills (CMR)
landing.sources: Sources: India Skills Report 2026; PLFS Annual Report 2025 via secondary source; CMR study reported by DQ India.
landing.how_title: Four steps from a degree to proof.
landing.step1_sub: Upload your CV and chat. See roles you fit now, could pivot to, and could stretch for.
landing.step2_sub: Problems from kirana stores, startups and NGOs, matched to your path.
landing.step3_sub: Chat with the business, share files, and submit your solution.
landing.step4_sub: Your report updates as the business shares results, with resume-ready lines.
landing.biz_title: Tell us your problem in your own language.
landing.biz_sub: Speak, type or upload a file. Kadam asks a few simple questions and writes it up. Students who want real experience will work on it.
landing.biz_note: No GST or registration number needed.
auth.footer: We send a 6-digit code to your email. No password needed.
